prd_facts.fact: A customer has a store credit balance in the same currency, zero by default (field store_credit_balance).
Checkout applies the credit after discounts and shipping, so it pays the final order amount.
The credit used is the smaller of the balance and the order amount, never above the order amount and never below zero.
The receipt has a new field store_credit_used (0.00 when none is used) and total is the amount still to be paid after the credit, 0.00 when fully covered.
Checkout itself does not change the balance; it decreases only when the order is confirmed, by exactly store_credit_used.
Confirming a receipt that used no credit leaves the balance as it is.
VIP, coupon, cap and shipping rules do not change, and adding credit to a balance is out of scope.
